newsitem.title: USA: Tosco to cut Calif. plant crude runs by 10,000 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Tosco to cut Calif. plant crude runs by 10,000 bpd.

text.p: Tosco Corp plans to cut crude oil runs at its 170,000 barrel-per-day refinery in Avon, Calif., by 10,000 bpd starting around Tuesday, said a trader familiar with plant operations.
"We are going to cut runs by about 10,000 bpd, probably starting tomorrow," the trader said on Monday.
He said weak West Coast refinery margins prompted the reduced runs.

Tosco owns four U.S. refineries, with two on the East Coast, and two on the West Coast. It operates a network of 4,000 retail stores -- including a chain of 2,500 Circle K convenience stores acquired in 1996 for $700 million.
